text.aria-label: Title text 'D5: day-ahead forecast, verified load-shift of -1.5 MW for 15 days Orange line: observed power. Black dashed: the normal running arrangement (observed minus the fitted load-shift). Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the load-shift. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode.'
text.tspan: D5: day-ahead forecast, verified load-shift of -1.5 MW for 15 days
Orange line: observed power. Black dashed: the normal running arrangement (observed minus the fitted load-shift).
Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the load-shift. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode.
